meta.name: pestel-delta-monitor
meta.description: Quarterly re-scan of a prior PESTEL analysis. Use when checking which macro factors moved, which assumptions broke, and what's new — turning PESTEL from a workshop artifact into a radar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期扫描宏观环境变化，更新PESTEL分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期需要追踪宏观因素变化并更新战略假设。
copy.tagline_en: Rescan macro environment changes and update PESTEL analysis quarterly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track macro factor shifts and update strategic assumptions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后，当你给出之前的 PESTEL 分析，Claude 会逐项对比六个宏观因素，只报告有实质变动的部分，并列出被打破的假设、新出现的因素、以及对战略或路线图的影响，最后给出下一步选项。
howto.when: 当你提到已有 PESTEL 分析并询问自那以来的变化，或提出新法规、事件想重新扫描时触发；需要有基线，否则会建议先做基础 PESTEL 分析。

say.text: 这是我们 Q1 做的 PESTEL 分析，之后有什么新变化？
say.note: 它会逐因素对比并生成报告。

say.text: 最近通过了新法规，请按这份 PESTEL 基线重新扫描。
say.note: 优先检查法规相关因素。

say.text: 请找出基线里哪些假设已经失效，并说明影响。
say.note: 输出会突出损坏的假设。

howto.what_en: When given a prior PESTEL analysis, it diffs each of the six macro factors against the baseline, reports only material changes, highlights broken assumptions and new factors, and provides implications plus next-step options.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a previous PESTEL analysis and ask what has changed, or mention a new regulation/event to re-scan. Requires a baseline; otherwise it recommends running a fresh analysis.

say_en.text: Here's our Q1 PESTEL analysis — what has changed since?
say_en.note: It produces a factor-by-factor delta report.

say_en.text: A new regulation passed; re-scan against this PESTEL baseline.
Which assumptions in the baseline are now broken, and what's the impact?
